title: Caymus Friendsgiving
seo_title: Caymus Friendsgiving Wine Dinner in Ozark, MO
description: Caymus Friendsgiving is a Thanksgiving-style wine dinner with Caymus wine pairings, where the restaurant handles the cooking and cleanup. Reservations are required and can be made by calling (417) 882-0399; tickets are $150, or $125 at the Cellar Society price. It takes place Thursday, November 19, 2026 at Vineyard Market, 1759 W State Hwy J in Ozark, MO, with happy hour at 6 PM and dinner at 7 PM.
